title: Bhawanathpur
text:
81. Bhawanathpur.—Bhawanathpur and Nagar Untari Police Station and G.Ps. Jarhi, Balekhar,

Raro, Sonehara and Dandai in Garhwa Police Station in Garhwa sub-division.
